theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.ocneanuWeight_twoRow_branching_diag {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq21 : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) (hgen : ∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < i → (q ^ 2) ^ i ≠ 1) (m : ℕ) :
ocneanuWeight q (q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1)) (twoRow m m ⋯) = ocneanuWeight q (q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1)) (twoRow (m + 1) m ⋯)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.ocneanuWeight_twoRow_branching {m k : ℕ} {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (q : R) (hq : q ≠ 0) (hq21 : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) (hgen : ∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < i → (q ^ 2) ^ i ≠ 1) (hk : k < m) :
ocneanuWeight q (q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1)) (twoRow m k ⋯) = ocneanuWeight q (q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1)) (twoRow (m + 1) k ⋯) + ocneanuWeight q (q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1)) (twoRow m (k + 1) ⋯)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.schurPrincipal_twoRow_pieri_diag {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (Q : R) (hgen : ∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < i → Q ^ i ≠ 1) (m : ℕ) :
(1 + Q) * QBeta.WenzlWeight.schurPrincipal 2 Q (twoRow m m ⋯) = QBeta.WenzlWeight.schurPrincipal 2 Q (twoRow (m + 1) m ⋯)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.schurPrincipal_twoRow_pieri {m k : ℕ} {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (Q : R) (hgen : ∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < i → Q ^ i ≠ 1) (hk : k < m) :
(1 + Q) * QBeta.WenzlWeight.schurPrincipal 2 Q (twoRow m k ⋯) = QBeta.WenzlWeight.schurPrincipal 2 Q (twoRow (m + 1) k ⋯) + QBeta.WenzlWeight.schurPrincipal 2 Q (twoRow m (k + 1) ⋯)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.card_twoRow {m k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ m) :
(twoRow m k h).cells.card = m + k

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.qBracket_pieri {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (x : R) (d : ℕ) :
(∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 1), x ^ i) * (1 + x) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (d + 2), x ^ i + x * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, x ^ i

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.schurPrincipal_twoRow {m k : ℕ} {R : Type u_1} [Field R] (Q : R) (hgen : ∀ (i : ℕ), 0 < i → Q ^ i ≠ 1) (h : k ≤ m) :
QBeta.WenzlWeight.schurPrincipal 2 Q (twoRow m k h) = Q ^ k * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (m - k + 1), Q ^ i

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.geom_oneSub {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (Q : R) (n : ℕ) :
(∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, Q ^ i) * (1 - Q) = 1 - Q ^ n

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.mul_geom_succ {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (x : R) (n : ℕ) :
x * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, x ^ i + 1 = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), x ^ i

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.prod_oneSub_telescope (R : Type u_1) [CommRing R] (Q : R) (d : ℕ) :
(∏ j ∈ Finset.range d, (1 - Q ^ (j + 2))) * (1 - Q) = (∏ j ∈ Finset.range d, (1 - Q ^ (j + 1))) * (1 - Q ^ (d + 1))

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.nPart_twoRow {m k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ m) :
∑ c ∈ (twoRow m k h).cells, c.1 = k

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.hook_twoRow_row1 {m k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ m) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < k) :
QBeta.WenzlWeight.hook (twoRow m k h) (1, j) = k - j

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.hook_twoRow_row0 {m k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ m) {j : ℕ} (hj : j < m) :
QBeta.WenzlWeight.hook (twoRow m k h) (0, j) = if j < k then m - j + 1 else m - j

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.cells_twoRow {m k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ m) :
(twoRow m k h).cells = Finset.image (fun (j : ℕ) => (0, j)) (Finset.range m) ∪ Finset.image (fun (j : ℕ) => (1, j)) (Finset.range k)

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.colLen_twoRow {m k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ m) (j : ℕ) :
(twoRow m k h).colLen j = if j < k then 2 else if j < m then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.rowLen_twoRow_one {m k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ m) :
(twoRow m k h).rowLen 1 = k

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.rowLen_twoRow_zero {m k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ m) :
(twoRow m k h).rowLen 0 = m

theorem QOU.SchurWeyl.mem_twoRow {m k : ℕ} (h : k ≤ m) (i j : ℕ) :
(i, j) ∈ twoRow m k h ↔ i = 0 ∧ j < m ∨ i = 1 ∧ j < k

def QOU.SchurWeyl.twoRow (m k : ℕ) (h : k ≤ m) :
YoungDiagram
